notes.title: BitSummit Report & Upcoming Events for SUMMER ROAD!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, this is Rebuild Games, the development team behind [b]SUMMER ROAD[/b].[/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth for [b]SUMMER ROAD[/b] at "BitSummit the 13th" from July 18th to 20th![/p][p]We were thrilled to see a constant stream of players at our booth throughout the three days. We believe this was largely thanks to the incredible display created by GYAAR Studio. Thank you so much for your amazing work![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcMLCM1Na7PUjt1R39C39-CBdHECN13WWpka7bTczRFfqDZ2NwzXYAMf9qUgNuzC4Da45jqlpjmRO9McWtpFQ2g55WnkNRkHLcZL-WwC0jICtPHA3qPp-TdZjLZpKcFEQCNnEGtQg?key=Oz1Hf8XRWT1lsR1JnTLo3g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeaIjruXmiYbukEmCNsUkDSOitOoZh2i9_jtvF_vncywGsC_sETkS3kddoykWiyFzJe3uD16sELiQKhJsIjwAm7A5Md4xWjDKhTwJpVKClSrT-6MrL_NG1tCJUQR5SYvUZLI4ud_g?key=Oz1Hf8XRWT1lsR1JnTLo3g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfWzu6B0u4QvEHv-ve7khEiH9nh54rKOfkHKlufd_II5h6-df8cHmLR7XuW_8v4g7v7LVF6sk8uEs2Sx3EHvf2rqHRrd6C80Mmq0bTp5LkeImkgYJlOJNyrYqrqjID5h7gO2tBczA?key=Oz1Hf8XRWT1lsR1JnTLo3g"][/img][/p][p]Watching you play the game firsthand gave us a wealth of valuable feedback.[/p][p][url="https://x.com/GYAAR_Studio/status/1947695630501220634"]https://x.com/GYAAR_Studio/status/1947695630501220634[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/GYAAR_Studio/status/1946447261506077020"]https://x.com/GYAAR_Studio/status/1946447261506077020[/url][/p][p]Many of you had a great time with our [i]garagara[/i] lottery machine! The novelty "Mogumo hats" also really stood out at the event![/p][p]In the demo version we showcased, we introduced a new "Position Switching" system.
We've been wanting to give players more active control over the frontline and backline roles within their team, and this was our first trial implementation of that idea.[/p][p]We will continue to fine-tune this system and plan to provide more opportunities for you to try it out at upcoming events. Speaking of which, [b]SUMMER ROAD[/b] is scheduled to be at the following events soon:[/p][list][*][p][b]August 3:[/b] Tokyo Game Dungeon 9 (Japan, Tokyo) - [url="https://tokyogamedungeon.com/"]https://tokyogamedungeon.com/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]August 8-29:[/b] BUSAN INDIE CONNECT FESTIVAL 2025 (Online) - [url="https://bicfest.org/exhibition/"]https://bicfest.org/exhibition/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]August 20-24:[/b] gamescom 2025 (Germany) - [url="https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/news/detail/84"]https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/news/detail/84[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][b]SUMMER ROAD[/b] is currently under active development. Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Our Publisher & BitSummit Showcase for "Summer Road"!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, this is Rebuild Games, the developers of [i]SUMMER ROAD.[/i]
From now on, we'll be posting updates here on the store page from time to time, so please stay tuned![/p][p]We have some huge news to share today. We are thrilled to announce that [b]Phoenixx Inc.[/b] will be the official publisher for "[i]SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite"[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42614556/e76a487f7b46a61a42560f669c7cb99a3a2a1671.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For those who may know, Phoenixx is the publisher behind other fantastic titles from the "Gyaaa Studio Indie Game Contest" (where we also won an award!), such as [i]Parry Nightmare[/i], [i]Electrogical[/i], and [i]The Strongest TOFU. [/i][/p][p]They are already providing us with amazing support as we work towards the full release. In the future, you can expect to see news about [i]SUMMER ROAD[/i] not only from us, but also on Phoenixx's social media channels. We can't wait to share more![/p][p][/p][p]And there's more! We'll be showcasing [i]SUMMER ROAD[/i] at [b]BitSummit 13th[/b] in Kyoto this summer.
You'll be able to play a demo of the game at both our publisher Phoenixx's booth and the Gyaaa Studio booth.[/p][p][b]BitSummit 13th:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://bitsummit.org/"]https://bitsummit.org/[/url][/p][p][b]Dates:
[/b]Business Day: July 18 (Fri)
Public Days: July 19 (Sat) & 20 (Sun)[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Miyako Messe (Kyoto International Exhibition Hall), Kyoto, Japan
9-1 Okazaki Seishojicho, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto City, Kyoto Prefecture[/p][list][*][p][b]3rd Floor, SV-13: Gyaaa Studio Booth[/b][/p][p][url="https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/bitsummit2025"]https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/bitsummit2025[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]3rd Floor, IP3-09: Phoenixx Booth[/b][/p][p][url="https://phoenixx.ne.jp/bitsummit13_20250714/"]https://phoenixx.ne.jp/bitsummit13_20250714/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Gyaaa Studio booth is putting a [b]"major, major, major"[/b] spotlight on [i]SUMMER ROAD[/i]. They've also given us an extra-large space for our demo station.[/p][p]We've heard that if you visit the booth, you can get an original [i]uchiwa[/i] fan and even a special Mogumo hat! We're so grateful for their incredible support, especially for a game that won its award a year ago...[/p][p][/p][p]Development on [i]SUMMER ROAD[/i] is moving full steam ahead. Right now, we're in the final stages of polishing the latest build for the BitSummit demo. Will we make it in time...?[/p][p]The game has changed significantly since we last showed it at the TOKYO INDIE GAME SUMMIT back in March, so we would love for you to come and try it out. Your feedback at the event will be a huge motivation for us.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support for [i]SUMMER ROAD[/i].[/p][p]
[/p]
